headword: {年賀状|ねんがじょう}じまい
gloss: ending one's New Year's card custom

definitions.gloss: ending one's New Year's card custom
definitions.explanation: The practice of formally ending the custom of exchanging New Year's cards ({年賀状|ねんがじょう}), usually by sending a final card that announces one will no longer send them. A growing trend, especially among the elderly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{年賀状|ねんがじょう}じまい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll end my New Year's card custom this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢|こうれい}→高齢：14648_kourei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{年賀状|ねんがじょう}じまい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More people are ending their New Year's card custom citing old age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{年賀状|ねんがじょう}じまい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{文面|ぶんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: My parent said they wanted to stop sending New Year's cards, so we worked out the wording together.

notes:
The suffix 〜じまい (from ⟦{仕舞|しま}う→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧, "to finish, to close") means putting an end to a practice. A {年賀状|ねんがじょう}じまい is usually announced on the final card itself.

USAGE:
- A recent social trend tied to ⟦{終活|しゅうかつ}→終活：27374_shuukatsu⟧ (end-of-life preparations) and the spread of digital greetings.

RELATED WORDS:
